record.one_liner: Command-line tool that renders Mermaid diagram definitions to SVG, PNG or PDF.
record.auth_notes: Local CLI/library with no account or API key shown in the fetched pages; the docs describe only installing the package and running mmdc or calling a Node.js function.
record.access_notes: Installed from npm with no sign-up; no credentials needed.
record.api_notes: Documented surface is the mmdc CLI and a Node.js run() function; the Node.js API is explicitly not covered by semver.
record.blocker_notes: Not a hosted SaaS; it is a local tool, so there is no vendor API to authorise. No official MCP server was found in the two searches; a community Python MCP wrapper exists.
